title: Fully Loaded Nachos
description: Fully Loaded Nachos are layered with crispy tortilla chips, melted cheeses, seasoned protein, beans, fresh vegetables, and creamy sauces for the ultimate shareable Mexican appetizer. Every layer is packed with flavor, texture, and restaurant-quality appeal.

ingredients.title: For the Nachos Base
items: High-quality tortilla chips (homemade or store-bought) – 200 g

ingredients.title: For the Protein (optional but recommended)
items: Ground beef, chicken, or pulled pork – 300 g

ingredients.title: For the Toppings
items: Black beans, rinsed and drained – ½ cup

ingredients.title: For the Sauces
items: Sour cream or Mexican crema – ½ cup
Salsa verde or roja – ¼ cup

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Protein
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; sauté until translucent.
Add ground meat and spices. Cook until browned and fully cooked.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Set aside.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Layer the Nachos
steps: On a large baking sheet or oven-safe dish, spread a layer of tortilla chips.
Sprinkle evenly with cheddar and Monterey Jack cheeses.
Scatter protein, black beans, corn, and a few diced tomatoes over the cheese.
Add a second layer of chips and repeat the cheese and toppings.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Bake
steps: Bake in the oven for 8–10 minutes, or until cheese is fully melted and bubbling.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Add Fresh Toppings
steps: Remove from oven and top with avocado, pickled jalapeños, red onion, and cilantro.
Drizzle with sour cream, guacamole, and salsa.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Serve
steps: Serve immediately while warm and cheesy. Perfect for sharing!

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately while hot and cheesy.
Pair with extra salsa, guacamole, or Mexican crema.
Perfect for parties, game nights, or sharing as a hearty appetizer.

chefTips: Use homemade tortilla chips for the crispest base.
Layer cheese between layers of chips to prevent sogginess.
Add a squeeze of lime over the top for a fresh kick.
Serve on a heated cast-iron skillet for that authentic restaurant feel.
Optional: drizzle a chipotle crema for smoky depth.
